title: St. Croix taxi tariff inventory — October 24, 2022 schedule
sourceNotes: VInow states the St. Croix rates went into effect October 24, 2022. Inventory is non-active until canonical endpoint, direction, passenger-tier, and additional-charge reconciliation passes the territory completion gate.

pricingModel.oneOrTwoPeople: published total fare for one or two people
pricingModel.threePlusEach: published per-person fare for groups of three or more

additionalCharges.unlistedDestination: Use nearest tariffed place crossed and next tariffed place ahead, based on the one nearest the passenger destination; do not implement as automatic inferred fare until separately modeled and tested.
additionalCharges.roundTrip: double one-way fare plus waiting charges
additionalCharges.radioPhone: fare plus one third of basic fare; for more than one person add $2 to each passenger

reviewFlags: Preserve STX passenger tiers exactly: 1 OR 2 PEOPLE is a group total; 3+ / EACH is per passenger.
Do not reuse STT/STJ one-person and two-or-more semantics for STX.
Source heading spells Carambola as CAROMBOLA; retain Carambola as the traveler/canonical spelling but require reviewed source-name normalization before activation.
Unlisted-destination interpolation is a published provision but must remain fail-closed until the nearest-before/nearest-ahead algorithm has governed geographic evidence and deterministic tests.
Full row-level transcription and direct/reverse comparison remain required before STX can be certified complete.
